//: THE LADDER OF OFFICES (docs/LADDER.md). The magistracies below the consulship. Each is held by a PERSON, for a term, and is filled by election every fifth year. A rung asks an age and, above the first, a rung already held. The consulship itself (offices.json) asks forty years and a praetorship.

rungs.name: Quaestor
rungs.description: The first rung: the accounts of the Reach. Four are elected. It asks twenty-five years and a place in any service.

rungs.name: Aedile
rungs.description: The city's works and its games. Two are elected, from those who have been quaestor. An aedile who gives games is remembered for it.

rungs.name: Praetor
rungs.description: The courts. Two are elected, from those who have been quaestor. Nobody stands for consul who has not sat here.
